method: Run actual candidate ARM64 libraries under qemu-aarch64-static with exported stub client APIs; derive Annex-B extradata and the first random-access AU independently using upstream FFmpeg BSFs on real H264/HEVC MP4 fixtures.
new_checks: Remove all parameter sets from the first random-access AU, retain/add leading AUD, and verify complete bootstrap sets of the expected types.
Strip parameters from resulting wire packet and verify that AUD, SEI and VCL payload is byte-identical to the input AU.
A second AU in the same generation is not seeded again; a flush makes the same AU receive identical bootstrap again.
Complete in-band configuration AU remains byte-identical.
Original avcC/hvcC path matches upstream BSF output byte-for-byte without duplicated parameter sets.
H264 SPS-only and HEVC VPS-only/SPS-only AUs receive a complete dependency-ordered prefix, followed by the original in-band parameter NAL unchanged.
v4 unknown wire DTS, original packet/frame timestamps, v3 pool lifecycle, v2 backpressure and all eight native-fallback comparisons still pass.
review_finding_fixed: Injecting only missing PPS before an existing SPS could invert dependency order. v5 now seeds complete filtered configuration only when the AU lacks a full configuration, then preserves in-band updates; full configuration AUs are unchanged.
limitations: No board, broker device, DMA or actual Firefox MSE execution in this audit.
These cases prove configuration transport behavior, not that missing extradata caused the observed Bilibili 64-packet/zero-frame session.
Real website diagnosis and hardware acceptance remain with root; private binaries are not publicly published.
